name: live-session-setup-tasks
description: POC: internal task tool for live commerce session setup (Node/TS API + React client).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
